items.name: Apex Phantom GT

items.name: Thunderbolt Stock V8

items.name: Vortex Dune Crusher

items.name: Turbo Dart 200cc

items.name: Trailfire Turbo 4WD

items.name: Mudlark Cross Car

items.name: Corsica '73 RS

items.name: Cyclone '69 Fastback

items.name: Comet 100 Classic

items.name: Blackline Cadet 60cc T1

items.name: Blackline Obsidian 125 Junior T2

items.name: Rosso Kart Veloce 125 Junior T2

items.name: Blackline Phantom 125 Senior T3

items.name: Rosso Kart Modena 125 Senior T3

items.name: Blackline Renegade 125 Shifter T4

items.name: Verde Kart Pro 125 Shifter T4
items.brakes_desc: OTK BSS Dual Front + Rear Discs

items.name: Iberian Relampago Cross T2

items.name: Lusitania Bravo Sport Cross T2

items.name: Vortek Quattro Touring AX T4

items.name: Bologna SuperBuggy Twin-Turbo T5

items.name: Rapid Dynamics SuperBuggy Biturbo T5

items.name: Vandorn Kronos Prototype T5

items.name: Crestline Sovereign Prototype T5
